scheme_name: Senior Care Ageing Growth Engine (SAGE) – Startup Support
overview: The Senior Care Ageing Growth Engine (SAGE) – Startup Support is a Government of India initiative under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment aimed at promoting innovation and entrepreneurship in the senior care sector. It supports startups developing products, services, and solutions for the elderly and Divyangjan (persons with disabilities) through financial assistance, mentorship, and market linkage. The scheme encourages the development of affordable, accessible, and scalable solutions for ageing populations. It operates as a pan-India program to foster inclusive growth in the senior care ecosystem.
objectives: Promote innovation and entrepreneurship in senior care and Divyangjan welfare
Support startups developing affordable and accessible products/services for the elderly
Provide financial assistance to early-stage startups in the senior care sector
Facilitate mentorship, incubation, and market access for selected startups
Encourage scalable and sustainable solutions for ageing populations
Strengthen the ecosystem for Divyangjan and senior citizen care through technology
eligibility: Startups registered in India as a Private Limited Company, Limited Liability Partnership (LLP), or Registered Partnership Firm, working on innovative products, services, or solutions for senior citizens and/or Divyangjan, with a focus on healthcare, assisted living, mobility, mental wellness, or age-friendly technologies.
benefits: Financial support in the form of grants, mentorship from experts in ageing and social sectors, incubation support, access to testing and validation facilities, market linkage opportunities, and visibility through government platforms and events.
financial_support: Selected startups receive a grant of up to INR 50 lakhs for product development, pilot testing, and market deployment, disbursed in milestones based on project progress and utilization of funds.
application_process: 1. Visit the SAGE portal at https://social.nic.in/sage 2. Register as a startup on the portal 3. Fill out the online application form with details of the innovation, team, and impact 4. Upload required documents including incorporation certificate, PAN, and project proposal 5. Submit the application for review 6. Await evaluation by the expert committee 7. If selected, sign the grant agreement and receive funds in tranches.
required_documents: Project proposal detailing innovation and impact
Details of any existing funding or support received
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year.
implementing_agency: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
caveats: Grant is subject to milestone-based disbursement and utilization review
Funds must be used exclusively for the approved project objectives
Startups must comply with reporting and monitoring requirements
Misutilization of funds may lead to recovery and blacklisting
